hypotheses.justification: If ε ≤ 0 the conclusion is trivial from hu: mass u P ≥ 0 by WeightedIncidence.mass_nonneg u hu P, so ε/2 * mass u P ≤ 0 (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg), and 0 ≤ mass u Q by mass_nonneg u hu Q. If 0 < ε, the existing proof applies. So the proof splits on the sign of ε. This hypothesis can be deleted together with hR.

If R ≤ 0 (and ε > 0): mass u P ≤ mass w P ≤ R ≤ 0 by CommonMeasure.mass_weight_mono w u hle P and hP. So ε/2 * mass u P ≤ 0 ≤ mass u Q, the last step by WeightedIncidence.mass_nonneg u hu Q. If R > 0, the existing proof applies. This can be deleted together with hε: the case ε ≤ 0 is handled as in that entry.
